title: Network Participation Agreements — Payment Run, Clean Claim and Prompt-Pay Interest Figures
content:
Cascade pays practices holding **Network Participation Agreements** in regular payment runs. These are the payment-timing figures for each agreement type: how often runs are made, how fast a clean claim is paid, the prompt-pay interest rate and minimum, and the payment method.

| Figure | Savings Network | Vision Network | DHMO Specialist | DHMO Primary Care Dentist | Premier Participating Dentist | PPO Participating Dentist |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days between payment runs | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| Calendar days after receipt within which a clean claim is paid | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Prompt-pay interest, simple, percent per year | 0 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Prompt-pay interest minimum (USD) | 0 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Payments only by electronic funds transfer | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Rounding of amounts | Half up to the cent | Half up to the cent | Half up to the cent | Half up to the cent | Half up to the cent | Half up to the cent |

## How the figures are read

- **Prompt-pay interest** is simple interest at the stated percent per year. It is paid on a clean claim that is paid after the clean-claim period, for each day late. The rate is 12 percent per year under every agreement type except the savings network agreement, where it is 0.
- **Minimum.** Interest below the minimum, 2.00 USD where a rate applies, is not paid.
- **Electronic funds transfer.** "Yes" means payments are made only by electronic funds transfer.
- **Rounding.** Amounts are rounded half up to the cent: an amount whose third decimal place is 5 or more rounds up to the next cent.

## Hypothetical example

A hypothetical DHMO specialist is paid by Cascade in payment runs every 7 calendar days, by electronic funds transfer only. A hypothetical savings network practice receives no prompt-pay interest figure at all, because its rate and minimum are both 0.
